definitions.benchmark: OLS slope through 11 centred 10-year observational means, year-5 to year+5; realised observations also on anthropogenic views. Requires observations through year+10.
definitions.retrospective: Endpoint derivative of a trailing 15-year quadratic fit to retrospective method estimates from the full observation record; GWI current outputs are the existing explicit retrospective proxy. These are revised estimates, not vintage forecasts.
definitions.current: Endpoint derivative of a trailing 15-year quadratic fit to annual current method outputs. This alternative may differ from the retrospective headline rate.
definitions.units: degrees Celsius per decade; ensemble mean; missing where a complete fitting window is unavailable.
